issues.title: Belt layout: flat diagonal V with a mid-pan latch vs y_47303's straps hanging by the armrest
issues.evidence: y_47303 (q17_ph_belts.png): on each pan the latch (grey cover + silver tongue) sits at the rear near the armrest, the teal tongue strap hangs vertically from the armrest/cushion gap down over the pan front with slack, and the navy strap runs diagonally across the pan front. Render: both straps flat on the pan meeting at a latch ~z -0.40 mid-pan; only the navy free end (every 2nd seat) drops over the lip.
issues.fix: On the draped side blocks move the latch to x0 + 0.17*s (armrest side), z -0.22, and drop the tongue strap as two boxes: a 4 cm vertical drop at the cushion side (x0 +- 0.215) then a band over the pan roll to the front face; keep the navy strap diagonal to the front. Bevel the over-lip pieces into one 3-segment curve (no hard horizontal seam).
